entry.title: New: Bill 220 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS SECTION 25-8-6 (KAILUA-HONALO URBAN ZONE MAP), ARTICLE 8, CHAPTER 25 (ZONING CODE) OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL – 10,000 SQUARE FEET (RS-10) TO NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL – 10,000 SQUARE FEET (CN-10) AT HŌLUALOA, NORTH KONA, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 7-7-009:008 (Applicant

Dr. Loi Chang-Stroman) (Area: 16,161 square feet) The Leeward Planning Commission forwards its favorable recommendation for this change of zone request, which would allow the applicant to expand services at the existing medical facility. The property is located at 77-311 Sunset Drive.

Latest action: Council: Bill 220 passes second & final reading - 12/18/24
